title: World Bloom — Wishes in Bloom! — Episode1 Growth, and...

meta.Event Outline: In the space between worlds, Miku and the other VIRTUAL SINGERS watch the young people of Shibuya strive towards their goals. Suddenly, a mysterious light brings a change to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everything seems to be sparkling today somehow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I think I got up a little too early.
Our morning practice isn't scheduled to start for a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An just messaged me...
“I got up early, so I'll be warming up.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome and Aoyagi are also going to be here soon...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We're all feeling the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Of course we are.
We all want to perform in the world's greatest event. To sing at Lasting ECHO Fest, we need to win RUSH BEATS.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Besides how we perform, we have a lot of other things to consider.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We have to do everything we can to stand on top of the world, and see what lies beyond.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I bet it must be as beautiful as the sight we saw from atop the wall.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get to practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... Huff...!
Just 300-meters to go...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I was able to give that talk show we did the other day everything I had...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I don't know what they're gonna throw at us next.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to keep practicing to make sure that I'm ready for anything!)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's Minori.>
<She's on the treadmill!>
<You can do it, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh, these comments...!
I must be on right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know. If everyone's watching me, then...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm done running! Now that I'm all warmed up, it's time for the Minorin Dance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope everyone watching will dance along, too!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's the Minorin Dance! Yeah!>
<It's kind of weird, huh?>
<This is gonna be an instant classic.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to spread hope to everybody watching.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (On the other side of the screen, people from across Japan—no, maybe even across the world, are watching me.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to give it my all, to reach them all around the world!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. Time to focus in for practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Soon, we'll be performing at the Center Theatre. We need to make sure that our show is a huge success.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Step one is practice. Step two is practice. Steps three and four are practice, and so is step five!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I should also take this opportunity to review and improve my rehearsal methodology.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can do that pantomime-only improv drill again. I'll leave no stone unturned!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If our upcoming show becomes a hit, then we'll be able to move on to the next stage.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, the demo for our next song is coming along nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if someone asked me whether or not it can save Mafuyu right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I tried taking a hard look at things, and I've thought about her situation... But nothing's worked.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, that song was so gentle...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I should at least try composing songs which show empathy for Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our new song should be finished soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thanks to Saki, this one is also turning out really well. I can't wait to have Shiho and Honami listen to it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now I feel like seeing everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <Did you all see that shooting star just now?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Message
rows.Line: <I saw something flash. Was that it?>

rows.Speaker: Honami's Message
rows.Line: <I made sure to wish that our solo show will be a success.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even if we're apart, we're still connected like this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Their feelings seem to have been growing even stronger recently.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure it helps that they're drawing closer to their goals, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What happened with those black fragments, as well as those strange encounters, seem to also be playing a role.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
I'm so glad that meeting everyone from those other SEKAI is having such a positive impact on them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if their feelings keep getting stronger like this, doesn't that mean something big is gonna happen again?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if their trees undergo another giant growth spurt?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That would be surprising for them, I'm sure...
But it's possible if their feelings become strong enough.
